mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_audit_logs (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail})
mapper.select:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.id ASC) AS list_number, l.id, l.actor_id, a.nick_name AS actor_nick_name, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, t.nick_name AS target_nick_name, l.detail, l.created_at FROM admin_audit_logs l LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = l.actor_id LEFT JOIN users t ON l.target_type = 'MEMBER' AND t.id = l.target_id
l.action = #{action}
l.target_type <> 'MAIL'
ORDER BY
l.id DESC
l.id l.created_at
CASE WHEN l.target_type = 'MAIL' THEN '서버 (자동)' ELSE COALESCE(a.nick_name, CONCAT('탈퇴한 회원 #', l.actor_id), '탈퇴한 회원') END
CASE WHEN l.target_type = 'MAIL' THEN '인증 메일' WHEN l.target_type = 'MODEL' THEN '추천 모델' ELSE COALESCE(t.nick_name, CONCAT('탈퇴한 회원 #', l.target_id), '탈퇴한 회원') END
CASE l.action WHEN 'ROLE_CHANGE' THEN '권한 변경' WHEN 'LOGIN_UNLOCK' THEN '잠금 해제' WHEN 'CHAT_WARN' THEN '상담 경고' WHEN 'CHAT_RESTRICT' THEN '상담 제한' WHEN 'CHAT_UNRESTRICT' THEN '상담 제한 풀기' WHEN 'CHAT_TRANSFER' THEN '상담 넘기기' WHEN 'CHAT_CLOSE' THEN '상담 종료' WHEN 'MEMBER_SUSPEND' THEN '계정 정지' WHEN 'MEMBER_UNSUSPEND' THEN '계정 정지 풀기' WHEN 'MAIL_SENT' THEN '메일 발송' WHEN 'MAIL_FAILED' THEN '메일 발송 실패' WHEN 'MODEL_TRAFFIC_CHANGE' THEN '모델 비율 변경' WHEN 'MODEL_SERVER_START' THEN '모델 켜기' WHEN 'MODEL_SERVER_STOP' THEN '모델 끄기' ELSE l.action END
CASE WHEN l.action = 'ROLE_CHANGE' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(l.detail, 'SUPER_ADMIN', '총관리자'), 'ADMIN', '관리자'), 'USER', '일반 회원') ELSE l.detail END
l.id
ASCDESC, l.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
